info.name: University Research Opportunity Portal
info.description: Run requests 01-14 in order against a running Flask/MySQL application. 01-10 cover all eight mandatory PDF scenarios. Creates three records, deletes the first, and deliberately retains two for your UI/video demonstration. Reruns create three new records and use newly returned IDs. No credentials are included. Error 500 is tested by the Python suite; to show it in Postman, stop MySQL and resend request 04, then restart MySQL.

request.description: Expected HTTP 201. Expected JSON: {"message": "Opportunity created.", "opportunity": {"title": "Network Traffic Analysis", "description": "Analyze university network congestion using captured traffic.", "research_area": "Computer Networks", "faculty_name": "Dr. Example Faculty", "department": "Computer Science", "required_skills": "Python, TCP/IP, Wireshark", "available_positions": 2, "application_deadline": "2026-12-20", "status": "Open", "id": 1}}
